nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $d \ge 0$ and $a_0, \dots, a_{d-1} \in K$. If a sequence $G \colon \mathbb{N} \to K$ satisfies $G_{n+d} = \sum_{i=0}^{d-1} a_i G_{n+i}$ for every $n \ge 0$, then the characteristic polynomial $X^d - \sum_{i=0}^{d-1} a_i X^i$ of this recurrence annihilates $G$.
nodes.title: The characteristic polynomial annihilates the solutions of its recurrence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be the translation operator $E(G_s) = G_{s+1}$ on sequences. If $A_i(E)$ annihilates $G_i$ for every $i \in I$, then $\prod_{i \in I} A_i(E)$ annihilates the sequence $s \mapsto \sum_{i \in I} c_i G_i(s)$. nodes.title: The Addition-Multiplication Lemma for annihilators

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $c \in K$, and let $E$ be the translation operator $E(G_s) = G_{s+1}$ on sequences $G \colon \mathbb{N} \to K$. Then the operator $E - c$, that is, $p(E)$ for the polynomial $p = X - c \in K[X]$, annihilates the sequence $s \mapsto c^s$.
nodes.title: The operator $E - c$ annihilates the powers of $c$

nodes.summary: For every semiring $K$ and every polynomial $p \in K[X]$, the operator $p(E)$ annihilates the zero sequence, where $E$ is the translation operator $E(G_s) = G_{s+1}$.
nodes.title: Every operator annihilates the zero sequence

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring, $p = \sum_i a_i X^i \in K[X]$ and $G \colon \mathbb{N} \to K$ a sequence, and let $E$ be the translation operator $E(G_s) = G_{s+1}$. The operator $p(E)$ annihilates $G$ when $\sum_i a_i G_{s+i} = 0$ for every $s \ge 0$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
